literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} failure! Used too much Psi Power! Let's rest a little...
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} failed!
Too much Psi Power used! Time for a little rest…
note: The {V} field is a power name (compare D01_8AF2 とうし　しっぱい！), so 'X failed!'. Same text as D09_B383.

literal: Will you try?
final: Try it?
note: D08_B3B1..B40A are 5-8 byte lines, possibly for a small 8-char box in the Psi Land games, so all kept very short.

literal: It's your turn!
final: Your turn!
note: 10 chars. If the box really is 8 wide: 'Your go!'

literal: It's my turn!
final: My turn!

literal: It's my win!
final: I win!

literal: You're amazing
final: You're good!

literal: Will you continue?
final: Continue?

literal: I won't lose
final: I won't lose!

literal: You did it!
final: You did it!

literal: Do your best!
final: Good luck!

literal: Don't be disappointed
final: Chin up!

literal: Kyaa, amazing!
final: Eek! Wow!
note: キャー is a delighted squeal.

literal: Points are insufficient
final: Too few points!
note: 15 chars. 'Not enough points!' is more natural if space allows.

literal: This is Psi Land. You can enjoy games that use psychic powers.
final: This is Psi Land, where you can enjoy games that use psychic powers.

literal: I don't feel anything!
final: I don't feel anything!
note: Same as D12_908D; the line after using FEEL on nothing.

literal: Welcome to Psi Land! I'm Minako. I work as the instructor here. The games here need Psi Power. If you lose, your vibrations will go down. So playing too much is forbidden. Choose the game you want to play.
final: Welcome to Psi Land! I'm Minako, the instructor here. These games run on Psi Power, and if you lose, your vibrations drop. So don't overdo it! Pick a game you'd like to play.
note: みなこ = Minako, the Psi Land hostess (not in the glossary yet).

literal: Do you understand the play system?
final: Do you know how to play?

literal: Choose the game you want to play.
final: Pick a game you'd like to play.

literal: Welcome to Psi Land! Choose the game you want to play.
final: Welcome to Psi Land! Pick a game you'd like to play.

literal: This is a game that uses psychokinesis. Whoever gets their character to the goal first wins. Press the button while concentrating your will. To play you need Psi Points. If you win, your Psi Points double. Now, I'll be your opponent!
final: This game uses Psychokinesis! Get your character to the goal first to win. Focus your mind as you press the button. It costs Psi Points to play, but win and your points double! Now then, I'll be your opponent!

literal: This is a game using clairvoyance. Minako lays a card face down first, so you use clairvoyance to see that card's number! Whoever plays the larger number wins. However, 5 loses to 1. And when the numbers are the same, you lose!
final: This game uses Clairvoyance! First, Minako lays a card face down, and you use Clairvoyance to see its number! Whoever plays the higher card wins. But a 5 loses to a 1! And if the numbers tie, you lose!
note: Kept her cute third-person 'Minako' (みなこ　が). Could be 'I' if it reads oddly.

literal: And whoever wins 3 times first becomes the winner of that round! If you win, your points double! But to play you need a certain number of points... are you all right? Well then, I'll be your opponent...
final: The first to win 3 times takes the round! If you win, your points double! But you need a fair number of points to play. Think you have enough? Well then, I'll be your opponent…

literal: This is a game using precognition. Use the Control Pad to move the girl character to the goal, up, down, left or right! The character won't necessarily move the way the Control Pad says. You have to foresee which way she can move!
final: This game uses Precognition! Use the Control Pad to move the girl to a goal at the top, bottom, left or right. But she won't always move the way you press! You must predict which way she can go!

literal: The multiplier written on the goal panel is applied to your points and added to your points! But to play you need points... are you all right? I'm cheering for you, so do your best!
final: The number on the goal panel multiplies your points, and the result is added to your total! But you need points to play. Think you have enough? I'm rooting for you, so give it your all!

literal: Sorry, but at your level you can't play yet!
final: Sorry, but your level is too low to play this yet!

literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} failure! Used too much Psi Power! Let's rest a little...
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} failed!
Too much Psi Power used! Time for a little rest…
note: Same text as D02_BB24.

literal: Let's try bending this spoon with psychokinesis.
final: Try bending this spoon with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's try twisting this spoon with psychokinesis.
final: Try twisting this spoon with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's try breaking this spoon with psychokinesis.
final: Try snapping this spoon with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's try playing the synthesizer with psychokinesis.
final: Try playing the synthesizer with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's try to foresee the place where it comes out next.
final: Try to predict where it will appear next!
note: Subject unstated in the Japanese (called from bank 2, near the spoon events); kept as a vague 'it'.

literal: Let's try to see, with clairvoyance, the color of the gum that comes out.
final: Try using Clairvoyance to see what color the gum will be!

literal: Let's try making the fountain spout with psychokinesis.
final: Try making the fountain spout with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's try to foresee where the fountain comes out.
final: Try to predict where the fountain will spout!

literal: Let's try to see the fountain's broken spot with clairvoyance.
final: Try using Clairvoyance to find what's broken in the fountain!

literal: Let's try making flowers bloom with psychokinesis.
final: Try making the flowers bloom with Psychokinesis!

literal: Let's see with clairvoyance what color airship comes out.
final: Use Clairvoyance to see what color the blimp will be!
note: ひこうせん = airship, rendered 'blimp' (see D12_93CF hangar).

literal: Please move this with psychokinesis.
final: Please move this with Psychokinesis.

literal: Please make an object materialize with psychokinesis.
final: Please make an object appear with Psychokinesis.

literal: Please teleport this with psychokinesis.
final: Please teleport this with Psychokinesis.

literal: Please see the hidden thing with clairvoyance.
final: Please use Clairvoyance to see what is hidden.

literal: Please see the color of the hidden thing with clairvoyance.
final: Please use Clairvoyance to see the color of the hidden object.

literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} success! Points went up by {V}{V}{V}{V}!
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} succeeded!
You gained {V}{V}{V}{V} points!
note: First field = power name, second = point count.

literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} failure! Will you try once more?
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} failed!
Try again?

literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} failure! {V} more times.
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} failed!
Tries left: {V}
note: 'Tries left: N' avoids '1 tries'.

literal: {V}{V}{V}{V} failure! Points went down by {V}{V}{V}{V}!
final:
{V}{V}{V}{V} failed!
You lost {V}{V}{V}{V} points!

literal: {NAME}. I am the Psi Master Guru. Now I will test your Psi Power. A graduate of the School should be able to do it! If you can't do something like this, you can't be called an Esper!
final: {NAME}. I am Guru, a Psi Master. I shall now test your Psi Power. Any graduate of the School can do this! If you cannot manage something this simple, you are no Esper!

literal: {NAME}, we met again. Then, let's test your Psi Power.
final: So we meet again, {NAME}. Now, let us test your Psi Power.
note: No speaker tag. Probably Guru's repeat visit (Jericho has his own, D10_84B1), so kept it dignified.

literal: Yes! I'm Shinobu, the happy-humming gal! Now, it's a chance! This round, points double, so do your best!
final: Hi-hi! It's Shinobu, the happy-go-lucky gal! Here's your chance! Points are doubled this round, so go for it!
note: るんるん = cheerfully humming; 'happy-go-lucky'. Contrast with きゃぴきゃぴ 'bubbly' in D10_83C5.

literal: That feeling just now was really good! Well, let's meet again when your vibes rise again!
final: Ooh, that was super good! Let's meet again when your vibes climb even higher!

literal: Hmm... that was a little unsatisfying! But don't get discouraged! I think we'll meet again sometime, so at that time... (you know)!
final: Hmm… that wasn't quite enough! But don't let it get you down! I bet we'll meet again someday, and when we do… you know!
note: そのときは　………ヨ！ is a coy unfinished promise. Chose 'and when we do… you know!' Other option: 'next time, I'm counting on you!'

literal: Yes! I'm Shinobu, the bubbly gal! Ta-da! To wonderful you, I'm boldly presenting a bonus of {V}{V}{V}{V} points!
final: Hi-hi! It's Shinobu, the bubbly gal! Ta-daaa! A whopping bonus of {V}{V}{V}{V} points, just for wonderful you!

literal: If you can't do it in {V} times, Psi Points go down.
final: If you can't do it in {V} tries, you'll lose Psi Points.

literal: (a bare line break)
note: Empty string used by shared engine code; kept as a single newline.

literal: Please make that person turn around with psychokinesis.
final: Please use Psychokinesis to make that person turn around.

literal: Please foresee the color of the car that passes next.
final: Please predict the color of the next car to pass by.

literal: Please foresee the place where a person comes out next.
final: Please predict where the next person will appear.

literal: Please make (them) turn around with psychokinesis.
final: Please use Psychokinesis to make them turn around.
note: No object in the Japanese; a shorter variant of D10_8424.

literal: I am Jericho. Let us test {NAME}'s Psi Power. Is that all right?
final: I am Jericho. Allow me to test your Psi Power, {NAME}. Shall we begin?

literal: We meet again. How is your condition? Then, let us test your Psi Power.
final: We meet again. How are you feeling today? Now, let us test your Psi Power.

literal: This is the Psi Salon. It's a hangout for Espers who graduated from the School.
final: This is Psi Salon, a gathering place for Espers who have graduated from the School.

literal: This is the Psi Park. It's the City's place of relaxation.
final: This is Psi Park, where the City comes to relax.

literal: I don't feel anything!
final: I don't feel anything!
note: Same as D08_B56D.

literal: I'm Esper Arima. Could it be you're {NAME}? (pause) I knew it! Actually, I've heard a lot about {NAME} from Esper Kiyota. That you have quite a lot of talent. By the way, {NAME}, in place of a business card, bend a spoon for me?
final: I'm Esper Arima. Could you be {NAME}, by any chance?{P}I knew it! Esper Kiyota has told me a lot about you, {NAME}. He says you have real talent. Say, {NAME}, why not bend a spoon for me? Call it your business card!
note: ありま = Arima (not in glossary). The blank line before やっぱりね！ is a beat, so {P}.

literal: Amazing! I felt strong vibrations!
final: Amazing! I felt some strong vibrations!

literal: Seems you're in bad condition today.
final: Looks like you're off your game today.

literal: {NAME}, you seem to be in very good condition. Show everyone spoon bending again.
final: You seem to be in great form, {NAME}! Show everyone your spoon bending again!

literal: {NAME}, you seem to be in very good condition. This time, show me spoon twisting.
final: You seem to be in great form, {NAME}! This time, show me some spoon twisting!

literal: {NAME}, you seem to be in very good condition. This time, show me spoon breaking.
final: You seem to be in great form, {NAME}! This time, show me some spoon snapping!

literal: There's a synthesizer!
final: There's a synthesizer!

literal: There's some kind of ornament!
final: There's some kind of ornament!
note: おきもの = a decorative figure. It's the object moved or teleported in D10_80F5 and D10_8121.

literal: There's a gum vending machine! Let's try buying one.
final: There's a gum machine! Let's buy one.

literal: I'm Mami. Nice to meet you. I graduated from Psychic School last year. Oh! {NAME}, you're a graduate too? Then I'm your senior. I really like this park. I often do it in psi training: with psychokinesis you can make that fountain over there spout. {NAME}, won't you try it once too?
final: I'm Mami. Nice to meet you! I graduated from Psychic School last year. Oh! You're a graduate too, {NAME}? Then I'm your upperclassman! I love this park. I train here a lot, and you can make that fountain spout with Psychokinesis. Want to give it a try, {NAME}?
note: The Japanese has no break between そつぎょうしたの and あら！ (likely a missing newline); read as two sentences.

literal: As expected! I felt very strong Psi Power!
final: Impressive! I felt very strong Psi Power!

literal: When your condition goes up, it'd be good to try again.
final: Give it another try when you're in better form.

literal: Today's vibrations seem good. I want to see the fountain.
final: Your vibrations seem good today. I'd love to see the fountain go!

literal: Today I'll try making the fountain spout. {NAME}, show me you can foresee where it comes out.
final: Today I'll make the fountain spout! {NAME}, you predict where the water will come up!

literal: Oh, {NAME}, just in time. The fountain seems to have broken. Won't you use clairvoyance to find the bad spot?
final: Oh, {NAME}, perfect timing! The fountain seems to be broken. Could you use Clairvoyance to find what's wrong?

literal: Please show me {NAME}'s Psi Power.
final: Please show me your Psi Power, {NAME}.

literal: There's a flower bed!
final: There's a flower bed!

literal: There's an airship hangar!
final: There's a blimp hangar!

literal: It's the place where I tuned my vibrations a while ago.
final: I tuned in my vibrations here earlier.
note: Shown when revisiting a spot already used this visit.

literal: Please choose a destination with the Control Pad.
final: Please choose a destination with the Control Pad.

literal: Moving to the Psi Salon
final: Heading to Psi Salon…

literal: Moving to the Psi Park
final: Heading to Psi Park…

literal: Moving to Psi Land
final: Heading to Psi Land…

literal: Teleporting!
final: Teleporting!

literal: Moving to the School
final: Heading to the School…

literal: This is Psychic City. Here you will accumulate practical training in psychic powers. It's important to train while imagining as if you had actually entered this world yourself. Don't rush, do it with a relaxed feeling. Just as before, when you feel something, please try using the FEEL command.
final: This is Psychic City. Here you will get hands-on training with your psychic powers. As you train, it is important to picture yourself truly inside this world. Take your time and stay relaxed. Just as before, when you sense something, try using the FEEL command.

literal: If you succeed at events, points go up. Also, when points exceed a certain amount, your Psi Level goes up. When your level goes up, you'll be able to hear information about psychic powers from Kiyota. And if you can raise your level to the maximum, at last you will challenge the final event.
final: Succeed at events to earn points. Once your points pass a certain amount, your Psi Level goes up. As your level rises, Kiyota will tell you more about psychic powers. And once your level reaches its maximum, you can at last take on the final event.

literal: If you succeed at the final event, {NAME} will experience the ending and become a true Esper! The place lit up now is the Center. To move, use the Control Pad to choose a destination and press the A Button.
final: Succeed at the final event, {NAME}, and you will reach the ending as a true Esper! The glowing spot is the Center. To travel, choose a destination with the Control Pad and press the A Button.
